description: Zephyr RTOS GPIO driver implementation for Atmel SAM0 microcontrollers, including configuration, interrupt handling, and port control functions.

methods.name: gpio_sam0_config
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags, setting direction, pull-up/down, and debounce.

methods.name: gpio_sam0_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads the raw input value of the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_sam0_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO port bits based on a mask and value.

methods.name: gpio_sam0_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specified bits in the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_sam0_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specified bits in the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_sam0_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specified bits in the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_sam0_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_sam0_get_pending_int
methods.description: Returns pending external interrupts for the GPIO port.
